Usage: ocfl export [flags]

Export object contents to the local filesystem

Flags:
  -h, --help             Show context-sensitive help.
      --root=STRING      The prefix/directory of the OCFL storage root used for
                         the command ($OCFL_ROOT)
      --debug            enable debug log messages

  -i, --id=STRING        The ID for the object to export
      --object=STRING    full path to object root. If set, --root and --id are
                         ignored.
  -v, --version=0        The number (unpadded) of the object version from which
                         to export content
      --replace          replace existing files with object contents
  -d, --dir="."          An object directory to export. Defaults to the object's
                         logical root. Ignored if --file is set.
  -f, --file=FILE,...    Object file(s) to export. Wildcards (*,?,[]) can
                         be used to match multiple files. This flag can be
                         repeated.
  -t, --to="."           The destination directory for writing exported content.
                         For single file exports, use '-' to print file to
                         STDOUT or a file name.
